info.title: FACET Remote Read API
info.description: Proposed contract for API-key-protected REST reads from one explicitly published immutable snapshot. /mcp uses standard MCP OAuth with a configurable external authorization server, optionally API keys; that transport is specified separately.

servers.description: Replace with the configured public origin

get.summary: Read optional feature state and documented limits.

get.summary: Read exact original YAML sections. Omitted selection lists names/sizes with null text, in document order; selected sections return in request order. Unknown or duplicate sections return 422.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact record ID; registry:id selects a named registry, :id explicitly selects the default registry. An ambiguous bare ID is 422.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Unique top-level or one-child section names, in requested order. Duplicate names are 422 invalid_selection.
